lines.en: I show up at the diner to see how Kaori's doing and she immediately asks her manager to go on break.
lines.zh: 我去餐厅看看 Kaori 过得怎么样，她立刻跟经理说要休息一下。

lines.en: It wasn't my intention to show up here and disrupt the business but, well, I guess it is what it is now since Kaori clocks out and sits down at the table with me.
lines.zh: 我本来没打算来这儿打扰生意，不过事已至此——Kaori 打了下班卡，坐到桌边陪我。

lines.en: She offers to give me her {i}One free human meal{/i} of the day as thanks for coming to say hello to her but I turn it down as the poor girl needs to eat as well.
lines.zh: 她说要把今天那“{i}唯一一份免费人类餐{/i}”给我，算是谢谢我来看她，但我拒绝了，因为这可怜的姑娘自己也得吃饭。

lines.en: And I don't mean poor in the literal sense.
In fact, Kaori works so often at so many places that I feel like she should probably be loaded.
lines.zh: 事实上，Kaori 在那么多地方打工，我觉得她应该挺有钱才对。

lines.en: Maybe the fact she needs to keep working so much is a...testament to how bad she is with money?
lines.zh: 也许她得一直这么拼命工作，恰恰证明了她有多不会理财？

lines.en: Either way, the two of us spend the next half hour trying to converse but failing miserably.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，接下来的半小时我们俩努力想聊聊天，却惨败收场。

lines.en: But despite her constant need to make things more difficult than they really are, she does show the desire to improve- and that alone is admirable.
lines.zh: 不过，尽管她总是习惯把事情弄得比实际复杂，她确实表现出了想要改进的意愿——光这一点就值得敬佩。

lines.en: I just wish it wasn't so taxing talking to her for extended periods of time.
lines.zh: 我只是希望跟她长时间说话不要这么累人。
